about_the_game:
You are being swarmed!

Send the hostile waves of worms back into the void solo or in 2 player online co-op!

Instead of many simple weapons:

3 extremely mechanically deep physics-based weapons that interact with each other and the environment!

Example: Blasts push Pebbles, Wisps and enemies into Rifts, resulting in them all colliding!

Instead of many stat-boost upgrades:

Each superpower choice is a unique and fully impactful upgrade on its own.

Example: An upgrade that boosts Hex-frenzy in melee range and INVERTS it into Antihex-slow at maximum.

Instead of needing meta-progress to win:

You can totally win without any unlocks as long as you manage to dodge everything! The unlocks remix the game.

Example: An unlocked mutation that allows Rifts to grow infinitely, never imploding!

Instead of slow many-minute runs with slow horde enemies:

Every level is extremely fast (can be slowed down with Antihex) and the enemies are few but very dangerous!

Example: If you abuse Blast, Hex and Energy upgrades, enemies will start violently pinballing around!

Feedback and Bug Reports

This game was built entirely from scratch—without an engine—using procedural, asset-free GPU-side graphics, solo. While we've tested thoroughly and incorporated past feedback, occasional issues may arise. Your bug reports are invaluable! Please report any graphics, sound, networking, or performance issues on Discord or the Steam Forums, and we'll address them as quickly as possible!

Bonus

A swarm simulation mode for when you just want to watch.

name: Super Swarmer Survivors

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit fully updated or: 1909 revision .1350+, 2004 revision .789+, 20H2 revision .789+
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD DX12, Nvidia DX12 (not Fermi, Shader Model 6.0 required)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Update your GPU drivers if you get "Shader Model 6.0 unsupported" warnings; only tested on Nvidia and AMD GPUs, Intel/Qualcomm might work but untested
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit fully updated
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shader Model 6.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 48kHz stereo
  • Additional Notes: Online Co-op: 1280+ MTU, 0.3MBps up/down, 200/200 pps

short_description: SSS is a very fast paced physics-based wave-based arena "anti-survivorslike" that respects your time in an eldritch petri dish with mechanically rich weapons that combo with each other and the environment.
